strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Ship WBD with exactly one long-lived public TCP-shaped 4-tuple per VPN session. FakeTCP owns the flow from the only SYN; the first seconds carry a Reality-like/TLS-1.3-like authenticated bootstrap over a bounded reliable setup stream; without FIN, close, or another SYN the same association switches to pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable LINK/FEC. Sustained payload must never inherit ordinary kernel-TCP head-of-line blocking.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: The single-flow architecture already exists on feat/single-flow-reality-faketcp / PR #9. Do not create another architecture branch. Current work is qualification and lifecycle hardening: make the one-SYN same-4-tuple E2E gate accurately observe the already-successful TLS->DTLS transition, restore mature Windows readiness/Npcap fixes, then investigate the separate RTT100 high-load/FEC regression without weakening the 40 Mbit release-point invariant.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not return to the retired dual-public-flow Reality TCP -> close -> FakeTCP design. Preserve one public flow, no sustained kernel TCP payload, pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3, immutable LINK, one raw lane, FEC off or fixed 20:20, and 40 Mbit/s aggregate-inner release point on <=100 Mbit/s weak links. Treat 60/80 Mbit as headroom characterization after the release point is stable.

architecture_override.required_public_flow: Exactly one TCP-shaped 4-tuple for the whole WBD session and exactly one SYN lineage. FakeTCP owns public sequence space from SYN through teardown.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: A bounded reliable ordered FakeTCP setup stream carries real TLS 1.3 / Reality-like marker and admission traffic during the first seconds. Approximately 99% externally observable Reality/TLS likeness is acceptable if perfect identity is impractical, but a second public connection is forbidden.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Authenticated setup switches in-band on the same FakeTCP association to DTLS/datagram mode; no FIN, RST, reconnect, or new SYN at the boundary.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Any reliable ordered behavior is setup-only. Post-switch payload delivery/recovery must not impose ordinary TCP cumulative-stream HOL.
architecture_override.server_port_model: WBD sessions are owned by the raw FakeTCP ingress from SYN. Do not rely on a separate kernel TCP Reality listener racing with the WBD raw flow for the same session.
